# LOG_ON

> LOG_ON is a Lagos-based AI and automation consultancy that designs custom AI agents, workplace RPA, analytics dashboards, and web systems for Nigerian and African businesses. We implement scoped projects—not a packaged SaaS product—and start with a free efficiency assessment.

## Core Services
- [AI agent development](https://logonai.netlify.app/ai-solutions): Custom agents, RAG, GenAI, ML for operations.
- [Workplace automation](https://logonai.netlify.app/automation): RPA and workflow design.
- [Web development](https://logonai.netlify.app/web-development): Next.js and custom applications.
- [Business analytics](https://logonai.netlify.app/business-analytics): Dashboards and reporting.
- [Chatbots](https://logonai.netlify.app/chatbots): Support and WhatsApp assistants.
- [Database solutions](https://logonai.netlify.app/database-solutions): Architecture and migration.
- [Training](https://logonai.netlify.app/training): AI and automation programmes.
- [All solutions](https://logonai.netlify.app/solutions)

## Proof (LOG_ON delivery records)
- Loan-processing automation: −60% approval time (financial services).
- E-commerce recommendations: +15% AOV (retail).
- Support RAG: −30% tickets (SaaS).
- Healthcare triage bot: ~40% inquiries autonomous.

## Pricing
Free AI Business Efficiency Assessment. Chatbots 2–4 weeks; automation 4–8 weeks; transformation 3–6 months. Typical operational return 6–9 months (2024–2026 records). Not a rate card.
